### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the change to preserve user-entered spaces when loading HTML. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #886 by preserving user-entered spaces when the web `EnrichedTextInput` loads HTML through `defaultValue` or `setValue`. **Changes:** - Applies shared `preserveWhitespace: true` parse options to both loading paths. - Adds round-trip tests with HTML normalization enabled and disabled, plus coverage for ignoring line breaks between blocks. - Leaves paste behavior and native implementations unchanged. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​web/​EnrichedTextInput.tsx` | Preserves leading, trailing, and consecutive spaces when loading HTML. | | `src/​web/​__tests__/​preserveWhitespace.test.tsx` | Tests whitespace preservation and pretty-printed HTML handling. |
Review effort: Balanced

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: web EnrichedTextInput now keeps user spaces when HTML is loaded through defaultValue or setValue. The raw summary, objectives, and description all describe this same change, so the title is related and specific.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description states the bug (spaces lost on defaultValue and ref.setValue() reload), the cause (setContent without parse options), the fix (preserveWhitespace: true rather than 'full'), a test plan, and a compatibility table. It matches the changeset and linked issue `#886` directly.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#886` requires that leading, trailing, and consecutive spaces survive loading HTML through `defaultValue` (`onCreate`) and `ref.setValue()` on web. The diff at head adds `SET_CONTENT_OPTIONS = { parseOptions: { preserveWhitespace: true } }` in `src/web/EnrichedTextInput.tsx`. It passes this object to both `e.commands.setContent(tiptapContent ?? '', ...)` in `onCreate` and to the `setContent(prepareHtmlForTiptap(...), ...)` call in `setValue`. Both load paths named in `#886` now disable ProseMirror's default whitespace collapsing. Because `<codeblock>` children are `<p>` nodes, the same option covers code-block indentation. The option is `true`, not `'full'`, so the issue's concern about pretty-printed inter-block newlines is addressed. The PR also adds `preserveWhitespace.test.tsx` with round-trip cases. I did not read that test file, so test behavior is taken from the PR summary. Playwright E2E tests were not run, and the PR reports this. Pasting is out of scope per `#886` and is unchanged.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR changes are limited to web `EnrichedTextInput` loading logic (one shared options constant applied to the two `setContent` calls) and a new web test file for whitespace round-trips. Every change maps directly to issue `#886`. The PR does not change native code, paste handling, or unrelated formats. The summary reports no changes to exported declarations.
